description: This Java abstract class defines a base data structure for objects that support user-defined attribute customization within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It manages attributes, including their retrieval, addition, and setting, and supports filtering active (non-voided) attributes. The class extends a change-tracking superclass and implements a customizable interface, facilitating extensible data modeling in medical records.

classes.name: BaseCustomizableData
classes.description: A generic abstract class providing customization of data entities via user-defined attributes within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the set of attributes associated with this object.

methods.name: setAttributes
methods.description: Sets the entire collection of attributes for this object.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of non-voided (active) attributes.

methods.name: getActiveAttributes(CustomValueDescriptor)
methods.description: Retrieves active attributes filtered by a specific attribute type.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the object and sets its owner.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Replaces existing attributes of a certain type with a new one, voiding previous if necessary.
